description: Send commands to Amazon CloudWatch Agent

action.description: The action CloudWatch Agent should take.

mode.description: Controls platform-specific default behavior such as whether to include EC2 Metadata in metrics.

optionalConfigurationSource.description: Only for 'configure' related actions. Use 'ssm' to apply a ssm parameter as config. Use 'default' to apply default config for amazon-cloudwatch-agent. Use 'all' with 'configure (remove)' to clean all configs for amazon-cloudwatch-agent.

optionalConfigurationLocation.description: Only for 'configure' related actions. Only needed when Optional Configuration Source is set to 'ssm'. The value should be a ssm parameter name.

optionalRestart.description: Only for 'configure' related actions. If 'yes', restarts the agent to use the new configuration. Otherwise the new config will only apply on the next agent restart.
